subject: mathematics
content: Let $f$ be a twice differentiable non-negative function such that $(f(x))^2=25+\int_0^x\left((f(\mathrm{t}))^2+\left(f^{\prime}(\mathrm{t})\right)^2\right) \mathrm{dt}$. Then the mean of $f\left(\log _{\mathrm{e}}(1)\right), f\left(\log _{\mathrm{e}}(2)\right), \ldots . ., f\left(\log _{\mathrm{e}}(625)\right)$ is equal to $\_\_\_\_$ .
